name: ED&F Man Sugar: Monthly Sugar Note

entries.title: Monthly Sugar Note – October 2026
key_points: Speculators drive the near term: net long ~223k lots on 20 Oct, near a 5-year high; expected to hold until the February roll.
Brazil CS to end-September: cane −1.6% y/y, sugar −13.6%, mix 47% vs 52%; October rain ~34% above normal and many lost crushing days; 2026/27 cane ~630 Mt, sugar ~37 Mt.
India 2026/27 ~27 Mt vs 28.5 Mt use after poor Maharashtra/Karnataka rain → import need; EU beet sharply lower (France lowest since 1980).
White premium flat at about $108/t Mar/Mar; main bearish risk is a weaker real pushing maximum sugar.
